# GlassPrinting.ie

> GlassPrinting.ie provides screen printing and branded printing services for glassware, bottles, jars and other drinkware from Tallaght, Dublin, Ireland.

GlassPrinting.ie and Hall Print Solutions are commercial brands of the same company.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.glassprinting.ie/): Glassware, bottles, jars, drinkware, printing services and FAQs.
- [Beer Mats and Premium Coasters](https://www.glassprinting.ie/beer-mats.html): Custom beer mats and reusable coaster options.
- [Contact and Request a Quote](https://www.glassprinting.ie/contact.php): Contact information and quote form.

## Confirmed details

- Address: Unit B6 South City Business Centre, Whitestown Way, Tallaght, Dublin, D24 V227, Ireland.
- Phone: +353 1 404 5145.
- Email: sales@glassprinting.ie.
- Homepage product categories include printed glassware, bottles, reusable cups, plastic drinkware, cosmetic packaging, jars, bespoke print and ceramics.
- Traditional Beer Mats: 1.4 mm absorbent board, round or square, full-colour printing on both sides; minimum order is 500 units.
- Premium reusable coasters: recycled PET felt, natural cork, bamboo and PU leather; Low MOQ applies to these materials.
- Other printed products are described as Low MOQ; confirm project-specific quantities when requesting a quote.
